scope: Init-only nominal 32768 Hz LSE SYSCLK on exactly CW32L011K8T6 and CW32L011K8U6, using Config.lse and unchanged native admission. Generic L011 and all L012 are excluded. Source qualification only; no hardware validation.
hardware_count_source: Own RM PDF57/66: fewer than 128 LSE edges in 256 LSI cycles detects running failure when LSECCS is enabled.
margin_source: Separate software margin: minimum_LSE_hz * 256 > 129 * 41000; smallest integral minimum is 20661 Hz. The extra edge is not the hardware threshold or measured LSI timing.

native_lsi_reference.basis: DS PDF51/printed48 Table7-19 factory -10/+25% over -40..85 C gives 29520..41000 Hz. RM PDF54/70 legal adjustment +/-10%, 30-36 kHz and approximate 0.4% steps are separate from DS 0.16% steps. Factory match and STABLE do not establish legality, actual frequency or cycle timing.

fallback.basis: RM PDF57/66 documents effective HSI4MHz fallback for detected selected-LSE failure with CLKCCS=1. Existing numerical /24 and DS PDF51 factory HSI +/-2% yield 3.92-4.08MHz after factory calibration. No HSI.DIV, HSIEN, CR0 or bus-divider post-fault state is proved. Admit full 4.08MHz on both buses even with CLKCCS=0; separately validate configured HSI at final divisors.

transition_policy: Retain guarded HSI-to-unchanged-LSI-to-factory-HSI bridge with latched entry-nonstable first-LSI-request admission. Do not write LSI TRIM/WAIT. Raise and verify Flash WAIT3. Check original non-WAIT CR2, IER, MCO, LSE and LSI TRIM/WAIT before and after refreshed admission. Install final divisors under factory HSI before the last LSE CR0 write; perform no later CR0 write. Final Flash planning covers LSE HCLK, configured-HSI HCLK and full 4.08MHz fallback. Publish only after final source/policy/mux/divider/pad/authoritative-WAIT checks.
cold_lsi_admission: Latch target && (needs_trim || needs_lsi) && !entry_lsi.STABLE. After retained admission and again immediately before LSIEN, reject RTC SOURCE2 or reserved4..7, UART1/2/3 SOURCE3 regardless RXEN/TXEN, enabled LPTIM ICLKSRC3, MCO SOURCE4, LSIRDY enable and enabled analog LSI filters even with zero filter count. Preserve exact gates, reject held resets and retain gate-restoration failure precedence. Permit/disconnect uninspected GTIM/ATIM selector9, GPIO filters, IWDT, cascades and external observers.
hsi_ownership: RTC SOURCE3 owns raw HSIOSC even when START=0 and requires enabled, stable, factory-matching HSI. HSI start/restart or initially-unready wait rejects MCO SOURCE3 and HSIRDY enable. Factory-ready DIV-only changes preserve raw HSIOSC. PB0 AF3 HSIOSC_OUT is a separate external observer.
auxiliary_projection: Remove only sysclk_detector. All prior native_low_power auxiliary facts and own proof bytes remain unchanged.
limits: StartupOnly loss can stop the CPU with STABLE still set and no failure flag. Poll budgets are CPU iterations only while execution continues.
Preserved fault routes can affect IRQs, timer capture/brake and external observers before return.
No frozen-clock validity, RTC continuity, recovery or bounded loss-to-fallback guarantee after source loss.
No LSI trim write, borrowed-flag clearing, RTC migration, runtime switching, wake/resume or silicon validation.

sdk_corroboration.authority_limit: Own selector/divider/startup and field corroboration only. SDK broad writes and erased-trim replacement values are not imported or treated as factory qualification.

source_conflicts: RM legal LSI +/-10% and30-36kHz are not replaced by DS factory -10/+25%.
RM LSI approximate0.4% trim step and DS0.16% are not silently reconciled.
RM permits1MHz LSE bypass; retain stricter DS100kHz ceiling.
entry_contract: Unchanged LSI must already be electrically legal for the board, including real reset entry. StartupOnly requires neither factory LSI nor preconfigured LSE; bridge readiness cannot manufacture the first monitored-preflight factory fact. No hardware-reset factory matching is assumed.
